description: This Java source file defines the UsersApiResource class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing application users in the Fineract platform. It includes methods for listing users, retrieving user details, creating, updating, deleting users, and handling user templates and bulk import operations.

classes.name: UsersApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class for user administration, handling endpoints related to application users such as listing, retrieval, creation, update, deletion, and bulk import.
annotations: @Tag(name = "Users", description = "An API capability to support administration of application users.")

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all users, with optional field filtering based on query parameters.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific user by userId, with optional template formatting.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a template for creating new users.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new user based on provided JSON data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT request to update existing user information.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.description: Handles POST request to change a user's password.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a user.

methods.name: getUserTemplate
methods.description: Handles GET request to download a user import template in Excel format.

methods.name: postUsersTemplate
methods.description: Handles POST request to upload a user import template in bulk.
